description: Estado tráfico tiempo real is a dataset listed in Valencia open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Ayuntamiento de València. Los datos de estado de tráfico se actualizan cada 3 minutos. En caso de que haya algún problema con la actualización de los datos aparecerá "Sin datos". Idtramo: Identificador único del tramo. Denominacion: Denominación del tramo. Estado: Estado del tráfico en tiempo real del tramo. Coverage: Valencia. The portal files it under Transportation. Its keywords are Transport networks. The portal shows 382 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-04-17 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-valencia-portal.
